% Coriolis force in shearing frame
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D2_coriolis}
\mathbf{F}_{\mathrm{Cor}} = -2\,\Omega_0\,\hat{z}\times\mathbf{u} = 2\,\Omega_0\,(u_y\,\hat{x} - u_x\,\hat{y})

% Shearing-periodic BC
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D2_sheared_periodic}
\text{field}(x = L_x, y, z, t) = \text{field}(x = 0,\ y - q\Omega_0 L_x t,\ z, t)

% Shear wrap-around time (BC is pure periodic again)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D2_tshear}
